objective_value: <float> Total cost combining service time deviation penalties, loading transportation costs, and unloading transportation costs.

vessels.vessel_id: <int> Unique identifier for the vessel, matching the instance data.
vessels.alpha: <int> Time step at which handling begins for the vessel.
vessels.beta: <int> Time step at which handling ends for the vessel.
vessels.berth: <int> Index of the berth assigned to the vessel.
vessels.profile: <int> Index of the selected quay crane profile from the vessel's candidate set.
vessels.subblocks: <list[int], length reserved_subblocks> Indices of the yard subblocks reserved for the vessel's containers.
vessels.handling_time: <int> Number of consecutive time steps required to complete handling under the chosen profile.
vessels.qc_per_timestep: <list[int], length handling_time> Number of quay cranes assigned at each successive time step under the chosen profile.

berths.rho: <int> Earliest handling start time step among all vessels assigned to this berth.
berths.varsigma: <int> Latest handling end time step among all vessels assigned to this berth.

qc_usage: <dict, key: '{time_step}'> Total number of quay cranes in use at each time step that has nonzero crane usage.
